reported_propositions.proposition: A contemporaneous summons identifies case 3205/2014 before Arrecife Investigating Court No. 1 and captions it as a Juicio de faltas; a later summary calls the same number DP 3205/2014.
The summons scheduled an October 2014 oral hearing concerning a historical minor-injury offence; occurrence and outcome are not located.
The police complaint records one complainant described as Community president and one affected party described as administrator.

The complainant said they attended in their claimed Community capacities to perform unspecified work, obtained entry after an access problem, refused a request to leave while seeking police mediation, inspected owners' apartments and became involved in a key dispute.
The complainant attributed physical contact to a man who said he was a tourist and said the administrator was injured when he intervened.
The complaint says the complainant's husband did not witness the alleged assault itself and that police arrived afterwards; it does not establish that nobody else witnessed it.
The complaint attributes no presence, instruction, agency or physical act to Gil Marer; the complainant said only that the alleged actor might be related to him.
Reported self-identification as a tourist is not guest-registration, employment or agency proof.
Later participant accounts and contemporaneous Community, regulatory and prosecutorial records provide context but are not formally linked to this proceeding.
No hearing record, judgment, dismissal, appeal or finality record was located.

Gil Marer alleges that the source-reported president and administrator held no legitimate office or work mandate and that their holding out of Community authority formed part of a criminal 2011-originating hijacking/capture.
A 7 October 2014 email proves the counter-allegation existed contemporaneously; it does not prove no office, forced entry, aggression, false complaint, intent or criminal liability.

Gil supplied private identity, prior-relationship and capacity details that remain outside Git to avoid an indirect identity bridge. Publicly, the 50+ guest/resident community setting supplies an ordinary reason for guest presence, while guest status, acquaintance or voluntary assistance proves no employment, marketing appointment, security responsibility, agency, instruction or concert.

The 2014 event may be used as a mid-chain corroborative lead in the alleged 2011 to 7 June 2018 continuity; it does not prove a common plan, CAM direction in 2014, later-actor knowledge, formal joinder or the 2018 command chain.

FMMM is one of the five people named in NEXUS 36 / DP 1901/2026; Aizpurúa is not one of those five and is presently classified by Gil as a material historical witness and possible future additional party, subject to evidence and full procedural rights.

Gil Marer expressly alleges that the disputed private-actor authority mechanism was criminal, not merely civil or innocuous, and contributed to later hotel, Community/CEXP and Acosta Matos-perimeter harm; this present attribution does not rewrite the contemporaneous source record or prove any offence, knowledge, intent, causation or liability.

The controlled matrix links all 17 public people and three protected role-only records to a dated sourced action, omission or express no-located-act statement across relevant tracks, with actor-specific limits and no transfer of responsibility by association.
